snippet.title: TORIMA HEADBANG - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Headbang to the beat, STREET PERFOWLER!

You are a badass bird thug with a sick crest. Strap on your HMD, throw your sanity away, and blast through the concrete jungle BACKWARDS on a mini-skateboard.  The better you match the rhythm, the more wind you blast — and the faster you RIDE!

Rhythm-synced chaos and unexpected hazards will come at you from every direction. But if you're riding the groove, nothing can stop you.  Smash through it all with sharp neck snaps and heavy shouts!

Earn legendary Titles like the Peregrine Falcon's god-speed or the Pigeon's relentless headbang count. Show the world what your neck is made of!

Let's Headbang!! 🤘
